motions.prompt: She stands in Mountain pose with arms by her sides. On a slow inhale she sweeps both arms out to the sides and up overhead until the palms meet, then on a slow exhale brings the joined palms down through the center to her chest and holds, breathing calmly. Feet never move.

motions.prompt: She holds the Tree pose exactly as in the reference image: the sole of the raised foot pressed on the inner thigh of the standing leg, well above the knee, never touching the knee. She begins with palms together at her chest; on a slow inhale she raises the joined palms straight overhead, arms beside her ears, and holds, breathing calmly. Neither foot moves.
